_: THE ONE LIST OF BUTTONS (the owner, 2026-10-17: 'make a complete list of buttons and remove the other ones', 'centralize it - if it's in one code place it's easy to update it later'). Every button the owner can press has ONE name, here, read by the server (taskuary/buttons.py), the page (website/src/buttons.js), the phone, the Advisor and the assistant's tools. A sentence may name a button only by a label on this list, and only when the item shows it. `row` lists the task page's own ids for the same act. `states` are the other words the same button shows while it works or before there is anything to act on.

reply.label: Reply
reply.hint: Write back to whoever asked - you see the draft before anything is sent

approve.label: Send
approve.hint: Sends the reply - the task stays open until you Mark done

state_hints.action: Runs only what the agent proposes - nothing happens before you press it, and the task stays open until you Mark done
state_hints.unknown: Nobody can say whether the first send went - this sends it again without asking the provider first, so they may get it twice

redraft.label: Redraft
redraft.hint: Has the AI write the draft again

close.label: Mark done
close.hint: Closes the task - it stops coming back

defer.label: Remind me
defer.hint: Put the task away until a day - it waits under For later on your rail and is back in front of you that morning

not_ours.label: Not ours
not_ours.hint: File it - the card asks whether just this once, from now on, or as a rule

not_ours_sender.label: Ignore this sender
not_ours_sender.hint: Their mail is filed for you from now on

block_sender.label: Block this sender
block_sender.hint: A rule in Settings - their mail never comes in

not_ours_kind.label: No more ideas like this
not_ours_kind.hint: The Advisor stops raising this kind of idea

mine.label: Put it on my list
mine.hint: A task on your own list - no agent starts

regular_agent.label: Send to agent
regular_agent.hint: Hand the work to an agent - the answer comes back here, and the card lets you change which agent

coding_agent.label: Send to coding agent
coding_agent.hint: Hand a change to code or a system to the coding agent

stop_agent.label: Stop and save
stop_agent.hint: Writes up what was done, stops the work, and drafts the reply to whoever asked - the task stays open

answer_agent.label: Answer it
answer_agent.hint: Type your answer in the box below - it goes straight to the agent that is waiting

continue.label: Continue
continue.hint: Pick the work up where it left off - say what to add, or continue as is

make_report.label: Make it a report
make_report.hint: This only reads and sums up - it is drafted as a report from the same reads, nothing saved until you save it

rerun.label: Run it again
rerun.hint: Runs the report again in the background - its result goes where the report sends it, and if it fails the bell says why

chase.label: Chase them
chase.hint: Drafts a short nudge on the thread, in your voice, copying whoever usually gets them to answer

let_go.label: Let it go
let_go.hint: Puts it down: the step is dropped or the follow-up closed

elsewhere.label: They answered elsewhere
elsewhere.hint: Say where they answered - the step closes as done

next.label: Next
next.hint: Puts this one down - still yours - and brings the next

state_hints.batch: Marks every notice on the card read - search finds them later - and brings the next

split.label: Split or merge
split.hint: Split this task in two, or merge it with another

state_hints.split: Splits this one into two jobs

close_note.label: Close with a note
close_note.hint: Closes the task with a line saying how it ended

share.label: Send out results
share.hint: Email what was found to someone

ask_sender.label: Ask sender
ask_sender.hint: Ask whoever sent it a question

remove.label: Remove - not a task
remove.hint: Taskuary stops making tasks from messages like this; the email itself is kept

run_another.label: Run another agent
run_another.hint: Start a second agent on the same task

retriage.label: Sort it again
retriage.hint: Ask the AI to read this one again and decide where it goes

fix.label: Fix it
fix.hint: Opens where what failed is fixed - the button shows the fix's own words, this name only where it has none

try_again.label: Try again
try_again.hint: Do the same thing once more

change_kind.label: Change who does it
change_kind.hint: You, an assistant, or a drafted reply for you to approve

assign.label: Assign it
assign.hint: You, an agent's profile, or nobody

pick_repo.label: Choose where the code is
pick_repo.hint: Which folder of code the agent works in

attach.label: Attach a file
attach.hint: Adds a file to the reply - nothing is sent until you approve it

report_bug.label: Report this bug
report_bug.hint: Opens a bug report with what went wrong filled in - you read it before anything is sent

new_task.label: New task
new_task.hint: Start a task of your own

state_hints.fix: A task of its own, carrying what failed and why - for an agent or for you to work

choices._: The card's own question after Not ours / Send to agent - answers, not buttons of their own
not_ours: From now on - their mail is filed for you
A rule in Settings - their mail never comes in

removed._: Buttons that no longer exist - an old saved card or a typed word lands on the verb named, the button is never drawn
